title: Domestic consumer unit
goal: Show a domestic distribution board with protected outgoing final circuits and clearly identifiable neutral and earth bars.

rubric.must: An incoming 230 V supply and a labelled S0 MAIN SWITCH are visible.
A labelled Q1 RCD rated 63 A, 30 mA, Type A is visible upstream of the outgoing breakers.
Six distinct QF miniature circuit breakers with different stated ratings are visible.
Lighting, sockets, cooker, shower, outside, and spare final circuits are each visibly labelled.
A TN1 NEUTRAL BAR with multiple numbered terminals is visible.
A TE1 EARTH BAR with multiple PE terminals is visible.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Main switch, residual current device, busbar and six outgoing breakers at real ratings, each final circuit returning to a numbered way on the neutral bar with its protective conductor on the earth bar at the correct cross-section.
